description: Identifier for a single play within a game.
A short description of the outcome of the play that the joint position data describes.
Identifier describing which player position the joint landmark locations are describing.
Timestamp of the corresponding frame of time series data. Each frame within a play should have a unique timestamp.
Label and x, y, z global position of a single joint for the labeled person / position. There are 29 joint landmarks that are tracked per frame of time series data.
